text:
chris (oncall): Pager: EU canary rollout v2026.03.17 showing 20% 503s and a spike in model response latency. Observability flags auto-rollback not triggered. Investigating.

devops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident alert - canary-failure-eu. Runbook: /runbooks/canary-failure. Pager routed to @chris (oncall).

taylor: seeing the same in tracing - multiple backends 504/empty responses from model-worker-3. No memory OOMs.

mina: can we flip the safety flag `feature_canary_eu` to 0 while we debug? That should drain traffic away from the canary quickly.

chris (oncall): @mina yes please. I don't want a full rollback if a flag flip is enough. Who can flip now?

luis: I can do the flag toggle. Doing `ff toggle feature_canary_eu=false --env prod --region eu` in 1m.

luis: toggled `feature_canary_eu=false` -> API returned 200. Confirmed via `GET /flags/feature_canary_eu` -> false.

devops-bot: Flag change detected: feature_canary_eu=false by luis. Traffic redistribution started.

taylor: traffic shifted, error rate dropped to ~6% -> still above baseline. Some pooled sessions sticky to old canary nodes.

chris (oncall): okay we should prepare for manual rollback if errors don't drop below 1% in 5m. Start rollback checklist: 1) block new canary traffic, 2) drain existing sessions, 3) trigger rollback job, 4) validate smoke.

mina: on it. Starting drain of canary pods in eu namespace: `kubectl drain deployment/canary-eu --grace-period=30 --timeout=300s`.

mina: drain in progress. A few stuck session connections showing `keepalive` in logs. Trying `kubectl exec` to force-close.

chris (oncall): if drains don't finish in 2m, we do forced rollback. Also notify CS if customer-facing requests impacted. @luis can you check top 5 customers by error spike?

luis: pulling top customers now — customer A and customer C show elevated errors. DMing CS lead and adding to incident spreadsheet: https://internal/redwood/incidents/1768412345

devops-bot: Drain complete on 3/4 pods; one pod failing readiness -> still receiving small fraction of traffic.

taylor: readiness probe failing on pod model-worker-3 with `connection reset` logs. Suspect process-level hang. I recommend rolling back the canary build to previous stable tag.

chris (oncall): agreed. Initiating manual rollback. Command I'll run: `rb rollback --env prod --region eu --tag v2026.03.16-stable --force --reason \"canary model flapping\"`.

chris (oncall): executing rollback now. Output: `rollback job queued (id 7512). draining sessions -> triggering deployment revision v2026.03.16-stable`.

devops-bot: Rollback job 7512 started by chris (oncall). Estimated duration 180s.

mina: monitoring rollout. Watching replication controller events and healthchecks.

luis: notified CS + support slack: "We observed errors during EU canary rollout; we've rolled back to previous stable model. We'll monitor and follow up." :email:

taylor: smoke tests: `curl -sS https://eu.gen.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'` -> response 200, latency 210ms. Ran 20 samples, all returned valid tokens.

chris (oncall): error rate back to baseline (~0.8%). Marking primary rollback successful. Still need to confirm no residual customer impact.

luis: Customer A saw ~0.4% request failures during window, Customer C ~1.2%. Both were short-lived. CS will reach out with incident summary.

mina: saving diagnostic bundle: `/var/tmp/incident-1768412345.tar.gz` and uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-incident-bundles/1768412345.tar.gz

devops-bot: Rollback job 7512 finished: success. Post-rollback health checks green.

chris (oncall): handing off to night on-call @eva for monitoring and small follow-ups. Eva, look at the post-rollback dashboard for next 4 hours and escalate if error rate >1.5% sustained.

eva: ack - taking over. I'll run a verification sweep and ensure CS notes are complete.

chris (oncall): thanks team. Action items: (1) postmortem draft, (2) add canary hardening step to runbook (auto-disable when readiness probe fails on >1 pod), (3) follow up with model team on worker hangs.

taylor: adding to backlog: ENG-8972 canary hardening + session stickiness fix.

luis: closing incident channel in 1h if no regression.

devops-bot: Incident resolved (rollback success). Incident timeline and artifacts at https://internal/redwood/incidents/1768412345/artifacts

chris (oncall): closing thread — good catch everyone. :white_check_mark:
